Hi Marta,

Thanks for sending the MSA/order form redlines earlier. To avoid back-and-forth between our legal teams, I'd like to propose a short exchange plan for the DPA exhibit / SCCs and a concrete evidence checklist so procurement can close the vendor review on our side this quarter.

Quick proposed plan (can we confirm by EOD tomorrow?):
- We (Redwood) send a filled DPA exhibit with tracked-in changes attached (see DPA_redline_v2.docx).
- Novacorp to confirm controller/processor roles and any required local-flow language for the UK/EU by next Tue (2025-07-08).
- Novacorp Legal provides the list of required evidence (SOC2, subprocessor roster, KMS assurances) and a single consolidated redline file if you have comments.
- If there are jurisdiction-specific SCC edits, we agree on a one-week window to finalize transfer addendum language.

To help move fast, can you confirm: which internal Novacorp mailbox should we route the technical evidence to (security@novacorp.com or legal@novacorp.com)? Also, do you expect a signed DPA + order form or DocuSign routing for separate exhibits?

Attachments: DPA_redline_v2.docx (redline, docx)

Thanks — I can host a 20-minute call tomorrow afternoon if that helps.

Best,

Evidence index (short):
- SOC 2 Type II report (last 12 months) — hosted via shared link in Drive.
- Subprocessor roster with hosting locations and whether they access logs.
- KMS approach: we support customer-managed keys via KMS integration or Redwood-managed KMS; let us know which you prefer and we will populate the KMS section.
- Export control / SCCs: we will accept in-band edits to the standard EU SCC modules but ask Novacorp to flag any language that would impose additional hosting constraints.

Proposed timeline:
- Today: Redwood sends exhibit + evidence index (attached).
- By Thu 2025-07-03: Novacorp Legal to send consolidated redline + any extra evidence asks.
- By Tue 2025-07-08: Parties finalize SCC edits and agree on execution path (single DocuSign for MSA + DPA or separate).

Attachments: redwood-dpa-exhibit-filled.xlsx (xlsx), DPA_redline_v2.docx (already sent)
